purpose: Close actual self-hosted passkey bundler dependency, beyond configurable URLs

sources.verified: Alto documents local RPC configuration, EntryPoint v0.7, OP-stack chain mode, funded utility/executor wallets, and debug_traceCall for safe-mode validation.
Source defaults safe-mode to true and exposes explicit RPC methods and mempool limits. Mutable main is not a release pin.
Build uses pnpm, TypeScript and Foundry contract artifacts; supported versions must be pinned and bounded before local execution.
Rundler documents EntryPoint v0.7 and Base support, but a second implementation is not required for this task.

decision: Prepare one real pinned Alto service with safe-mode validation, local-chain proof of existing Safe/account compatibility, and no provider or hosted-bundler fallback. Do not follow documentation advice to disable safe-mode for public service. No deployment or funds authorized by this research.
